title: Cuscuz nordestino with fried egg
steps: Mix the flocão with salt and 100 ml water and leave to hydrate for 10 minutes.
Steam it covered in a cuscuz pot or steamer basket for 8–10 minutes.
Fry the eggs in a pan with a little butter.
Turn the cuscuz out onto plates and serve with the fried eggs, sliced cheese and tomato.
